tools.name: Systematic Debugging
tools.description: Root-cause investigation, reproducible failures, and hypothesis-driven debugging.
tools.notes: Upstream cross-references test-driven-development and verification-before-completion; all three are included in presets. Copies the skill directory, not the full Superpowers plugin.

tools.name: Test-Driven Development
tools.description: A test-first workflow with guidance for meaningful regression tests.

tools.name: Verification Before Completion
tools.description: Require fresh verification evidence before claiming a change is complete.

tools.name: Python Testing Patterns
tools.description: Practical pytest fixtures, parametrization, mocking, async testing, and coverage guidance.

tools.name: Python Packaging
tools.description: Build Python libraries and CLIs with package metadata, wheels, and release workflows.

tools.name: Context7
tools.description: Retrieve library documentation and version-specific examples for coding tasks.
tools.notes: Node.js >=20.18.1. The upstream stdio README documents an optional API key for higher limits/private repositories; service policies and availability apply. Set credentials through your agent, never commit secrets.

tools.name: Playwright MCP
tools.description: Browser inspection and interactive web testing through accessibility snapshots.
tools.notes: Node.js >=18 plus a supported browser. First browser use may require a browser installation. This entry configures the MCP server; it does not install browser binaries.

tools.name: Fetch MCP
tools.description: Retrieve web pages as text/Markdown for documentation and research.
tools.notes: uv/uvx and Python >=3.10. This is an upstream reference server; assess URL/network access for your environment. No private-IP bypass is enabled.

tools.name: GitHub MCP Server
tools.description: Official GitHub tools for repositories, issues, and pull requests.
tools.notes: Configure authentication and allowed toolsets with the official installer. No credentials or remote OAuth flow is provisioned by this CLI.

tools.name: Serena
tools.description: Expose semantic code navigation, references, diagnostics, and edits to coding agents through an MCP-to-LSP bridge.

install.runtime: uv/uvx + Git; Python 3.13 selected by uvx; language-specific dependencies

tools.notes: Pins stable v2.1.0. uvx selects Python 3.13 (upstream supports >=3.11,<3.15); Git and network access required. Generic single-project ide context, explicit LSP backend and tools interface; dashboard/browser/GUI disabled. Language-server dependencies may download at first project activation; some languages need an external toolchain. MCP handshake and discovery of 22 tools verified on macOS in a temporary Python project; symbol operations and individual agent UIs were not exercised.

tools.name: Chrome DevTools MCP
tools.description: Inspect browser performance, network activity, and runtime behavior.
tools.notes: Browser lifecycle and environment requirements are configured upstream.

tools.name: Sequential Thinking MCP
tools.description: A reference server for structured problem-solving tool calls.
tools.notes: Current npm release 2.0.0 requires Node.js >=24. Kept out of the starter runtime and installer until separately tested.

tools.description: Rule-based static analysis for security issues and code patterns across multiple languages.
tools.license: LGPL-2.1 (community engine); additional offerings/rules have separate terms

tools.name: Bandit

tools.name: pip-audit
tools.description: Audit Python environments and dependency specifications against known vulnerability data.
tools.notes: Select the actual project environment or supported requirements/lock inputs. Uses external vulnerability data; can require dependency resolution. Not automatically installed or run.

tools.name: Gitleaks
tools.description: Detect committed or working-tree secrets using configurable rules and allowlists.
tools.notes: Install the CLI or official CI integration, select history/directory scan scope, and keep findings private. Review and rotate real leaked credentials; deleting a finding does not revoke a secret.
